messages:
tom-cs: FYI — Marigold Tech renewal window next week. They're asking to move from 12mo to 10mo, request 7% off, and want monthly billing. Onboarding ~60%: SSO done, data ingest pending schema sign-off. Procurement needs vendor code + EU VAT on PO. DocuSign blocked by their IT policy. Need pricing confirmation, VAT handling, KMS clause, and signature fallback. cc @carla-fin @leo-legal @sara-enable

priya-se: Thanks Tom. Seat count? Ramp plan? Any perf concerns that affect Dedicated vs Hosted?

tom-cs: Starting 12 seats, ramp to 16 by month 2. They asked for temporary Dedicated during ingest to guarantee latency.

carla-fin: Baseline $130/seat/mo. Math: 12 * 130 * 10 = 15,600 pre-discount. 7% off => 14,508 total. If billed monthly: 12 * 130 * (1-0.07) = 1,455.12/month (round to $1,455). Need PO and payment method to finalize. Wire is preferred for EU, card ok if they want immediate.

leo-legal: We can do a 10-month addendum and accept monthly billing. For VAT: invoice must include EU billing entity and VAT ID. If PO lacks VAT ID, we'll invoice from US entity and VAT is customer responsibility. On KMS: customer wants customer-managed HSM. We can accept subject to KMS addendum and attestation. Regarding e-sign: if DocuSign blocked, accept secure-uploaded signed PDF or wet-sign. I'll add clause: "Alternate signing via secure portal upload accepted where third-party e-sign is disallowed." Also need signatory name/title on PO.

sara-enable: I'll schedule two sessions: admin + technical for the week after sign. Need sample data and SSO SP metadata by 2026-04-08 to run ingest tests. Will prepare a short first-week runbook.

upload-bot: Upload portal: https://files.redwood.com/upload/marigold-2026-xy1 created by tom-cs

tom-cs: Reaching out to customer about vendor code and PO; they'll attempt secure upload and wire. They accepted the 7% in principle if PO/wire in by EOD Wed.

carla-fin: Finance can approve 7% provided PO has billing entity + VAT and Net30 monthly invoices. Please send PO & wire instructions to billing@redwood.com. We'll confirm revenue recognition details once we have invoice cadence.

priya-se: I'll hold the canary rollout until ingest tests pass and billing/contract are cleared. @sara-enable please confirm when test data ingests cleanly.

leo-legal: I'll draft the 10-month addendum + KMS addendum and post to the contract thread. Expect to post by EOD today.

tom-cs: Plan recap: 1) Customer to upload wet-signed PO to portal + wire instructions by EOD Wed; 2) Legal to post addenda today; 3) Finance to confirm monthly wire handling; 4) Enablement scheduled week after sign; 5) Priya to hold rollout pending ingest test. I'll update renewal tracker when PO is in.

carla-fin: Ping me when upload happens and I'll route to billing ops.

tom-cs: Thanks all — closing thread here until PO uploaded.
